limits: Watch/recovery options recorded in configuration; exact notification attribution and recovery overlap are not isolated.
Generated streamed tail is controlled allocation pressure outside project source; it is not representative repository code.
Three samples per condition/profile; finite observations, not browser latency tails or randomised speedups.
Unlabelled capture tracing disabled; latest operation measurements may describe recovery rather than the foreground edit.
Compatible cache preparation, pressure setup and independent verification are outside write-to-publication timing, but affect process peaks.
Child 12 GiB virtual-address-space limit is not RSS/physical-RAM enforcement or baseline-laptop qualification.
Actual idle scheduler admits cleanup and waits for recovery before admission; no three-way overlap is forced.
Only generated-tail cuts at least as large as the fixture signal cleanup entry; no artificial truncate delay.
Recovery-observed cases record running status before writing, not an instrumented capture or parse interval.
Native watcher callback release may outlast coordinator join; qualification waits for release before final storage checks.
Quiet time can elapse during pressure setup; unblocked shutdown observations do not establish a deadline.
